Hi Sam / Aisha / Camila \u0014

Thanks for the context \u0014 Marissa here (Solutions Eng). I'm taking point on the SIG workbook. A few answers and notes inline to keep things clear:

1) Deployment & Data flows:
- If Brightwell chooses Hosted API, data is processed in our multitenant environment with encryption-in-transit and encryption-at-rest; Dedicated gives isolated GPU pools and network isolation (VPC). Both options support a BAA. Please confirm whether ingestion will be API-only or include S3 transfers.

2) PHI / HIPAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads under a signed BAA. We have documented technical safeguards (encryption, RBAC, audit trails) and organizational safeguards (security training, incident response). We'll attach the BAA template for legal review.

3) SOC 2 & evidence:
- Current posture: SOC 2 Type I completed (controls as of 2027-03); Type II is in progress with expected completion Q4 2027. In the interim we can provide control descriptions, evidence packages (policy documents, screenshots), and our penetration test report.

4) Audit logs retention:
- We can provide 12 months of API/access logs for default retention. If you need longer-term storage of customer data/artifacts, we can discuss export or dedicated retention policy in Dedicated deployments.

5) Vulnerability scanning / pentest:
- Quarterly vuln scans and annual third-party penetration test; we provide summary reports and remediation timelines.

6) Timeline for SIG workbook:
- Once you confirm data flow (API vs S3) and whether we should return a completed workbook vs upload to OneTrust, I can commit to a first-pass completed workbook within 2 business days. Full supporting evidence (policies, screenshots) may take 4-7 business days to assemble.

Next steps:
- Sam / Aisha: confirm ingestion method (API-only vs S3) and whether you want the workbook returned or uploaded to OneTrust.
- Camila / Rishi: I'll start populating the Brightwell_SIG_v1.xlsx and will flag any items requiring Brightwell input (e.g., customer-specific encryption keys, KMS details, or retention opt-outs).

Thanks \u0014 happy to hop on a short sync if helpful.
